hero.title: The Nation's Platform.
hero.description: A unified media streaming platform built for the Libyan community. Listen to live radio, follow national broadcasts, and stay connected to the news and content that matters to you - anytime, anywhere.

features.title: Designed for the Community
features.description: The Nation's Platform is built with modern, user-first tools that ensure you stay connected with your community seamlessly.

backgroundPlayback.title: Keep Listening in the Background
backgroundPlayback.description: Allow notifications so our app can keep your radio playing while you use other apps or lock your device. Playback controls appear right in your notification panel.

volumeLevel.title: Set Up Radio Volume Level
volumeLevel.description: Tune the radio playback volume independently within the app without affecting your main Android system volume level.

broadcasting.title: Unified Broadcasting
broadcasting.description: Stream diverse content, talk shows, Libyan heritage programs, and news channels simultaneously on multiple platforms with our official applications.

optimizedStreaming.title: Optimized Streaming
optimizedStreaming.description: Enjoy crystal-clear audio streams with minimal data usage, built for reliable connections across all regions.

about.title: Our Vision, Mission & Goals
about.description: A national media platform delivering professional content that strengthens communication and reflects the aspirations of the Libyan community.

vision.label: V
vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: To be a leading national media platform that strengthens communication, promotes awareness, and serves the Libyan community.

mission.label: M
mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: Deliver trusted media that promotes transparency, supports institutions, and serves the public interest.

goals.label: G
goals.title: Our Goals
goals.description: Create meaningful content, strengthen media partnerships, and promote community awareness.
